title: getSnapshot must return a cached value

slides.say: Seeing the error, the result of get snapshot should be cached? Your snapshot is new every call.
React re-renders when the snapshot differs from last time. A new object every call always differs, so you get an infinite loop.
If the store holds immutable data, return it directly.

slides.text: Mutable store? Build a new snapshot only when data changed; otherwise return the last one.
slides.say: If the store is mutable, create a new snapshot only when the data really changed. Otherwise return the same cached snapshot.
